question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e661236d2ade86be0106e6f4065bb11156adfe02544acbedea5d56db77773d61.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

In a mirror image, when mirror is placed vertically to the object, the image will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and **Right Hand Side** will interchange their positions while top and bottom will be same.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f6beeac1a75b7260cd8ddb7e75336e08e8a5fd49a024d490cc60c45d6fdae69.png] 

Only option (2) is following this pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **option (2).**
